text:
Last post I called it 90s anime. It wasn't — it was modern cel shading with a retro palette.

This is actual 90s.
Thick outlines. Flat color fills. Dark purple haze. 
The elf girl vs tentacle monster — and she loses.

Two-line prompt. Japanese. That's it.

Made with Seedance 2.0 on @higgsfield_ai

💎 Prompt below
content: アニメ風の画風で素材『プリキュア対触手怪』を生成。戦況は激しく、プリキュアは敗北する。90年代アニメの美学、懐かしさ。
